description: Just before 8:30 am on Friday, Nov. 30, a 7.0 earthquake struck Southcentral Alaska. Rachael, Nevada, September 19 & 20, 2019, the Area 51 raid, scenes at the gate.  I spent the night in the huge parking area Thursday night.  It was relatively lightly attended at this point, but the festival was not to officially begin until Friday September 20.  Reportedly 1,500 people attended the first night, but only 150 went to the gate.  Here are scenes at the gate at about noon Friday.  It was basically a lighthearted party atmosphere once you got over the initial issues of apprehension.

Rollin Coxe

The town, about 240km north of Las Vegas, lacks a grocery store or even a gasoline station.
